final_results.types: Both app builds and explicit new tests pass
final_results.go: Affected 7 package targets pass (preflight package/CLI compiled, no standalone tests; exercised in isolated DB harness)

source_of_acceptance: Owner's 2026-09-21 direct relay; no separate ChatGPT reply file/ID supplied. E19 accepts previous linked fulfillment only. E20 is review pending.
failures_and_corrections: Before-fix Go failed semantic authoring/runtime regressions as intended.
Initial POS empty-catalog fixture masked BXGY; corrected catalog before production edits gave both bundle and BXGY failures. Second before-fix output was tool-truncated; retained as such.
Backoffice vector path corrected from one directory too high.
New POS fixtures supplied loyalty fields and corrected parked vs automatic-pending count assertions.
Linked fixture gained required isBOGO type field; final explicit typecheck passes.
First isolated DB run rejected correctly but test expected a machine code absent from existing localized HTTP error; assertion corrected, full run repeated on fresh empty fixture.
PowerShell initially collapsed missing-target native status2 to wrapper1; exact exit propagation subsequently verifies2.

Local default-encoding inspection/rewrite produced Unicode comment damage in three Go files; restored against entry, reviewed resulting minimal diffs and reran affected Go checks. Two readback scripts also failed encoding before explicit UTF8 correction; no surviving incidental text change.

checks: SHOW data_directory exact named fixture match
Empty schema required before 45 existing migrations
No old stopped cleanup retried or bypassed
fixture_safeguards.fresh_second_cluster_reason: Corrected localized-message test assertion; existing populated fixture intentionally not reused/deleted.

limitations: Backoffice Save button tested through real server rendering with only initial wizard index mocked; no browser interaction. Save callback source-traced.
POS planner/reducer tests are real pure modules; not native-device qualification.
KV is successful memory storage, not power-loss durability proof.
Online direct route vs offline batch is trusted server mapping; no payload-origin redesign.
No live/staging catalog rows scanned. Only deliberately seeded synthetic rows found by actual diagnostic.
No resource compression, overlap allocator, migration, quote/receipt or loyalty redesign.
Other malformed/missing BXGY reward-line drop behavior remains unchanged outside semantic overlap; parent captured-fact and quote work open.
Ordinary Go run skips opt-in historical integration suites when DSNs absent; only named LF+semantic harness freshly executed.
No release/concurrency/Redis/provider qualification; limited artifact secret-pattern scan not full A37 coverage.
No subagent used under current delegation restriction; local self-review only.
